header.description: What: Test-town. An M1 "Tank" (BasicVehicleSop, no order) stands in the open at (262,215), 65 m north of the 15 m block's north leg (x 230-250, y 110-150) — ⛔ not (262,195): since CE-4691 (a hide hides the WHOLE hull) it reaches a true hide behind the block in ~9 s, before the TOW is ready, and nothing is ever launched; ⛔ not (262,165): the L-Block hides it from the Bradley there (measured /perception/los). "Shooter", an M2 Bradley 170 m west (100,225), is told to attack it (LandPlatformAttack) with its TOW. Judge: (1) the Bradley launches a TOW at the tank (2) within 3 s of the launch the tank fires ONE salvo of its smoke dischargers (mount 2) at the Bradley — the fan of grenades bursts 30 m out between them (3) the tank leaves the open: it backs out of the Bradley's sight into its own hide (~288,227 from this start, measured CE-4691; it chooses it, the cover search) (5) the Bradley never hits it again after the screen (4) a second salvo never follows the first within 30 s. Fail: no salvo, a salvo without a launch, or the tank stays in the open. CE-4670 VA-S5, DESIGN_Vehicle_Appearance_State §6f.
